description: - Fixed the app crashing when a reminder fired on a phone where location permission isn't granted: refreshing a task started the location tracking service just to tell it there was nothing to track, and Android killed the whole app because the service has no location permission. The crash also took any WhatsApp or SMS being sent at that moment with it, which is why a WhatsApp reminder could fire and then not arrive. The service is now only contacted when it is already running, and it stops quietly instead of crashing if it isn't allowed to run.
